decisions.decision: USB_CONFLICT guard order: check usbConflict before gphoto2Available in TetheredAdapter.init()
decisions.rationale: When gvfs holds USB both flags are true — checking gphoto2Available first made USB_CONFLICT unreachable, breaking SC#4
